MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 32

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 24

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

6. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 24

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

9. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 25
   D. 24

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

12. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 26

13. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 12
   C. 13
   D. 4

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
